classification.question_topic: Asking if others have recently experienced intense dreams with strong continuity on returning to sleep, but with blocked/blurred dream memory and inability to recall details of events/places.
classification.skip_reason: No describable dream locations, entities, events, or spatial layout details are provided—only meta-level comments about dream intensity, continuity, and impaired recall.

meta.author_theory: Something is 'blocking my memories completely' (stated as a felt sense; no mechanism described).

extraction.extraction_notes: Phenomenological content is limited to dream meta-features: (1) 'past 2 nights' of 'very intense dreams'; (2) if waking mid-night and returning to sleep, the dream continues 'right back to the same place/ situation' from before waking; (3) inability to recall details—memory described as 'blocking', 'almost blurry', 'blurred and jogged'; (4) author reports typical recall range: 'everything, bits and pieces,' or periods of blurred memory.
